apiKey.title: API key (optional)
apiKey.description: Your samgovapi.io key. Free plan with 10,000 credits a month, no card: https://samgovapi.io/sign-up. Leave empty for a free preview of up to 5 real rows.

dataset.title: What to fetch
dataset.description: Contract opportunities are SAM.gov notices you can bid on. Entities are SAM.gov registrations with UEI, CAGE, NAICS and expiry. Exclusions are debarred, suspended and restricted parties. Awards are federal contract awards from USAspending.

keyword.title: Keyword or name
keyword.description: Opportunities: words in the title or the solicitation number. Entities: legal or DBA name, UEI or CAGE. Exclusions: name contains. Awards: recipient name contains.

naics.title: NAICS code
naics.description: Opportunities and awards: NAICS code or prefix, for example 5415. Entities: 6-digit NAICS code the entity lists.

psc.title: PSC code
psc.description: Product and service code, for example D399 or R425.

setAside.title: Set-aside
setAside.description: Opportunities: set-aside code such as SBA, 8A, WOSB, EDWOSB, SDVOSBC or HZC. Entities: business type or SBA program code such as 8A or A2.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter state: place of performance for opportunities, physical address for entities.

agency.title: Agency
agency.description: Opportunities and awards: department, sub-tier or awarding agency name, for example Veterans Affairs.

agencyCode.title: Agency code
agencyCode.description: Opportunities and awards: agency code such as 097 (Defense) or 047 (GSA).

openOnly.title: Open bids only
openOnly.description: Opportunities: only active notices that are not award notices and whose response deadline has not passed.

postedFrom.title: Posted from
postedFrom.description: Opportunities: posted on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

postedTo.title: Posted to
postedTo.description: Opportunities: posted on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

deadlineFrom.title: Deadline from
deadlineFrom.description: Opportunities: response deadline on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

deadlineTo.title: Deadline to
deadlineTo.description: Opportunities: response deadline on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Use it for bids closing this week.

expiringWithinDays.title: Expiring within (days)
expiringWithinDays.description: Entities: registrations that expire within this many days. Awards: contracts whose potential end date falls within this many days (likely recompetes).

uei.title: UEI
uei.description: Exclusions: exact UEI. Awards: recipient UEI.

fiscalYear.title: Fiscal year
fiscalYear.description: Awards: federal fiscal year of the award action.

minAmount.title: Minimum obligated ($)
minAmount.description: Awards: obligated at least this many dollars.

actionFrom.title: Action date from
actionFrom.description: Awards: action date on or after, YYYY-MM-DD.

actionTo.title: Action date to
actionTo.description: Awards: action date on or before, YYYY-MM-DD.

vehicle.title: Contract vehicle
vehicle.description: Awards: contract vehicle name, for example OASIS or SEWP.

maxRequests.title: Max API requests
maxRequests.description: Stop after this many requests on your samgovapi.io plan. Each page of up to 100 rows is one request.
